name: EXS Cherry & Peach Flavor Lube Water Based Lubricant 5ml x 4 Pack Combo | UK | Wedding, Honeymoon, Valentine Couple Combo Pack
description:
Enhance intimate moments with the EXS Cherry & Peach Flavor Lubricant Combo, specially designed for couples. Perfect for weddings, honeymoons, or Valentine’s Day, this premium water-based formula offers smooth, long-lasting pleasure.

Key Features:

Dual Flavors – Cherry & Peach: Adds fun, exciting flavors for a more enjoyable and playful experience.

Water-Based & Non-Tacky: Smooth, natural-feeling lubrication that is easy to clean.

Long-Lasting & Condom Safe: Provides extended lubrication and is fully compatible with latex condoms.

Paraben-Free & Skin-Friendly: Gentle on sensitive skin, ideal for intimate use.

Couple-Friendly Combo: Perfect gift for weddings, honeymoons, or Valentine’s Day celebrations.

Specifications:

Brand: EXS (UK Based)

Pack Size: 4 x 5ml Pouches

Made In: Turkey

Ingredients: Hydroxy Ethyl Cellulose, Glycerin, Monopropylene Glycol, Citric Acid, Sodium Saccharin, Methyl Hydroxybenzoate, Deionized Water

Celebrate intimacy and pleasure with the EXS Cherry & Peach Lube Combo Pack — a thoughtful, fun, and romantic choice for couples.
